description: This file contains Pydantic schema models for API request/response data structures related to data insights, audit events, validation, and evidence packages.

classes.name: AuditContext
classes.description: Schema for audit context information for attributable actions.

classes.name: SignatureBlock
classes.description: Schema for electronic signature evidence.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Standard error response schema.

classes.name: DatasetReference
classes.description: Schema for dataset reference within a package.

classes.name: SchemaField
classes.description: Schema for defining individual schema fields.

classes.name: SchemaDefinition
classes.description: Schema for dataset schema definition.

classes.name: ProductMetadata
classes.description: Schema for product metadata information.

classes.name: ControlsMetadata
classes.description: Schema for controls and retention metadata.

classes.name: DataProductPackage
classes.description: Schema for data product package details.

classes.name: CreateDraftRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to create a draft.

classes.name: CreateDraftResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a draft.

classes.name: CreateSubmissionRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to create a submission.

classes.name: CreateSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a submission.

classes.name: GetSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Schema for response when retrieving a submission.

classes.name: ValidationCheck
classes.description: Schema for validation check results.

classes.name: ValidationReportSummary
classes.description: Schema for validation report summary.

classes.name: ApprovalPreconditions
classes.description: Schema for preconditions required for approval.

classes.name: ApproveSubmissionRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to approve a submission.

classes.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after approving a submission.

classes.name: TriggerValidationRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to trigger validation.

classes.name: TriggerValidationResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after triggering validation.

classes.name: AuditEvent
classes.description: Schema for audit event details.

classes.name: GetAuditEventsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response when querying audit events.

classes.name: EvidenceArtifact
classes.description: Schema for evidence artifact reference.

classes.name: EvidencePackageResponse
